node.statement: If B is noncommutative, node #2 has an equivalence class C of size d>=2, because a direct sum of singleton blocks is commutative. Choose distinct indices 1,2 in C and set u=e_12+e_21 and v=e_11-e_22, with all other matrix-unit coefficients zero. Then u=u*, v=v*, and u^2=v^2=p:=e_11+e_22. Since p is a nonzero projection, ||p||=1, and the C*-identity gives ||u||=||v||=1. Direct multiplication gives [u,v]=2(e_21-e_12). For w=e_21-e_12 one has w*w=p, so ||w||=1 and consequently ||[u,v]||=2.
